verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS customer-support platform, and such a product could plausibly publish its source under an open license, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. The docs, MCP server, API and webhooks are product access features, not source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
